dct_description_sm:
Point layer of bus stops of the Régie de transport en public de Shawinigan (RTCS) on the territory of the city of Shawinigan.

! [Shawinigan logo] (https://jmap.shawinigan.ca/doc/photos/LogoShawinigan.jpg)
! [RTCS logo] (https://jmap.shawinigan.ca/doc/photos/RTCS-Copie.jpg)

**Collection context**
 Update Google Maps as well

**Collection method**
 Location at the corresponding address

**Attributes**

* _objectid_ (_OID_): 
* _direction_ (_String_): Direction
* _shuttle_ (_String_): Shuttle
* _hcar_a_ (_String_): Express A
* _hcar_b_ (_String_): Express B
* _hcar_n_ (_String_): Shuttle 1
* _h_nw_ (_String_): Shuttle 2
* _address_ (_String_): Address
* _sequence_a_ (_Integr_): Stop ID
* _Shelter_ (_String_): Bus shelter
* _mob_reduit_ (_String_): Access to reduced mobility
* _latitude_ (_Double_): Latitude
* _longitude_ (_Double_): Longitude
* _notes_ (_String_): Notes


For more information, consult the metadata on the Isogeo catalog (OpenCatalog link).**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
